why: Directory order is filesystem order, which differs between machines; the set must be read by name so the pool's partition, `--report` files and the log are the same everywhere. RE-ANCHORED for issue #653, which nested the layout one level deeper (`manifests/<area>/<id>.json`) and rewrote the reader as a walk. The outer sort is the one this mutates; the inner sort over an area's entries is covered by the same test, which asserts the flattened id order across both levels.
killedBy: readManifestFiles / readManifest reads every *.json in a directory sorted by name, ignores other files, and reads a single file as itself
